name: melody-planner
description: Local-first life planner with 3D VRM companion, activity tracking, tasks, routines, and calendar

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:lan: MELODY_LAN=1 concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n server,web,electron -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:4310/api/health && npx tsx electron/dev-launch.ts"
scripts.dev:electron:lan: MELODY_LAN=1 concurrently -n server,web,electron -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:4310/api/health && npx tsx electron/dev-launch.ts"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
